payload.queryText:

# GraphQL queries typically start with a "{" character. Lines that starts
# with a # are ignored.
#
# An example GraphQL query might look like:

query DataFlows {
  customerProduct(
    #where: { number: { _eq: "1094.301.071" } } 
    first: 10) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
				 product {
				   id
				 }
        customer{
          name
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

payload.name: Mutation Ship Load
payload.queryText:
mutation Mutation($payloadShipmentLine: [ShipmentLineUpdatePayloadInput!]!,
  $payloadShipment: [ShipmentUpdatePayloadInput!]!,
  $payloadLoad: [LoadUpdatePayloadInput!]!,
  $payloadInventory: [InventoryUpdatePayloadInput!]!,
  $payloadMasterInventory: [InventoryUpdatePayloadInput!]!
) {
  updateShipmentLine(payload: $payloadShipmentLine) {
    id
    number
    pickSequence
    shipmentId
    shipmentLineStageId
    productId
    purchaseOrderLineId
    salesOrderLineId
    salesOrderLineReleaseId
    transferOrderLineId
  }
  updateShipment(payload: $payloadShipment) {
    id
    number
  }
  updateLoad(payload: $payloadLoad) {
    id
    number
  }
  updateInventory(payload: $payloadInventory) {
    id
    number
    locationId
    lotId
    masterInventoryId
    productId
    productStrategyProcessId
    shipmentLineId
    supplierId
    workOrderId
    workOrderProcessId
  }
    updateMasterInventory(payload: $payloadMasterInventory) {
    id
    number
    locationId
    lotId
    masterInventoryId
    productId
    productStrategyProcessId
    shipmentLineId
    supplierId
    workOrderId
    workOrderProcessId
  }
}

payload.name: Update Inventory
payload.queryText:
mutation Mutation($payload: [InventoryUpdatePayloadInput!]!) {
  updateInventory(payload: $payload) {
    id
    number
    locationId
    lotId
    masterInventoryId
    productId
    productStrategyProcessId
    shipmentLineId
    supplierId
    workOrderId
    workOrderProcessId
  }
}
